# Support

For normal usage questions and reasonable requests, contact `1259081855@qq.com`.

Support is provided on a best effort basis, with no response-time commitment. A message may not receive a reply, and custom implementation, manuscript review, or private consulting is not included by default.

Please do not send PDFs, manuscripts, credentials, unpublished results, personal data, or other sensitive material unless the maintainer has agreed in advance. Describe the problem first and share only the minimum information needed.

Issues, Discussions, Projects, and Wiki are intentionally disabled to reduce interruption. Focused pull requests remain available for concrete, reviewable improvements.
